V1_plus_V15_plus_V24.net_chiral_module: one generation in each W33 sector

boundary: Exact optimization within standard-charge multiplets and conjugates. Arbitrary exotic gauge representations were not searched.

global_standard_charge_optimization.boundary: anomaly-free signed spectrum but not a PSp(4,3)-module-respecting repair
global_standard_charge_optimization.objective: minimize added one-particle dimension using standard multiplets and their conjugates

proof: For a common target module R, the minimum additions are the representation-ring symmetric differences from the existing V1,V15,V24 assignments. Coefficientwise weighted medians give V1 as the smallest nonzero target and V15 as the smallest nontrivial target.
vectorlike_only_repair: impossible because vectorlike pairs contribute zero to every anomaly coordinate
